question: What distinction must be known regarding clan and non-clan in relation to the goddess?
premises: Non-clan and clan must be known
The clan of the goddess is mentioned
inference: One must know both non-clan and clan, including the clan of the goddess
uncertainties: The syntactic role of the second occurrence of kulaṃ is ambiguous without further context
plain_english: O fair one, having known non-clan and clan, and the clan of the goddess.
